# Multi-source business analysis

The activity owner needs an order and payment reconciliation. Aggregate payments at order grain before joining; distinguish orders, paid amounts and unpaid orders.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
[
  {
    "id": "A1",
    "channel": "web",
    "ordered": 12000,
    "paid": 12000
  },
  {
    "id": "A2",
    "channel": "community",
    "ordered": 8000,
    "paid": 8000
  },
  {
    "id": "A3",
    "channel": "web",
    "ordered": 6000,
    "paid": 0
  }
]
```

## Failure prevented
Duplicating the order amount for each payment inflates the first order.

files.query.sql: SELECT o.id,o.channel,o.cents AS ordered,COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS paid FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT "order" AS id,SUM(cents) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY "order") p ON p.id=o.id ORDER BY o.id;
